draft_en.subject: If your monitoring installs still use 8-camera PoE cabinets - one number and one question
draft_en.body:
Hello IST Surveillance team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 18 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

If your monitoring installs still use 8-camera PoE cabinets: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $84.1 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity), CE/RoHS/UKCA, neutral brand.

One question: which recorder brand do you pair the switch with - that tells me whether the 8-port or a 16-port is the right one to detail?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
